1.consolidated_definition: fil. Criterio, punto de vista. Sistema particular de creencias o normas de vida personal o grupal. Usual. DRAE: desde 2001. Los administradores coloniales han partido de la filosofía de que según otros pueblos han tenido riquezas que exportar y explotar, la riqueza incalculable de la Isla reside en su fuerza de trabajo, frente a la presunta pobreza de recursos minerales
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Philosophy. Criterion, point of view. A particular system of beliefs or personal or group norms of life. Usual. 

From 2001 onwards, colonial administrators have based their philosophy on the idea that, according to other peoples' experiences with exporting and exploiting their riches, the island's incalculable wealth lies in its workforce, as opposed to the presumed poverty of mineral resources.
